'''2011 Match Play Championship Day 1 Kevin Shannon DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Kevin Shannon]] at [[2011 Match Play Championship]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Shannon
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 7.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
